convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'CenterOfGravityOSMA' and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position opening/closing logic. Custom indicator cannot be auto-replicated in Python without reimplementing its calculation.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: Signal-based close: buy close triggered when macd[1]>macd[2] (downtrend detected), sell close triggered when macd[1]<macd[2] (uptrend detected). Close is gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input with MarginMode enum (LOT vs MARGIN) controls interpretation: LOT mode=fixed lots when negative, MARGIN mode=fraction of free margin. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles the logic.

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions: (1) macd[1]<macd[2] for buy direction (or macd[1]>macd[2] for sell) confirming trend direction, AND (2) macd[0]>macd[1] for buy (or macd[0]<macd[1] for sell) confirming momentum reversal within the trend. This is a zero-lag OSMA oscillator with double smoothing. Signal bar index defaults to 1 (previous closed bar). When SignalBar==0, the EA processes every tick instead of waiting for new bars. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The CenterOfGravityOSMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is a Center of Gravity oscillator with double smoothing (OSMA-style histogram). The COG formula involves linear regression weighting, then two rounds of MA smoothing applied to the histogram. TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) must be reimplemented - they handle margin calculation, order sending with deviation, and global variable tracking for signal timestamps. The SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points and need 5-digit awareness (multiply by 10 if _Digits==5). Signal bar default of 1 means signals are evaluated on the last closed bar, making backtesting feasible with OHLC data.
